svg.title: Workflow: Payments desk transformation
svg.desc: Solution workflow (hybrid) for Payments desk transformation: 1 trigger: Desk agent enters the case number in the AI workspace → case fetched from the CRM; 2 system: Queries the payment gateway and reservation system for payment and existing booking → status shown; 3 decision: Booking already exists? yes → step 9 / no → step 3a: payment failed? yes → [HUMAN] escalate to team lead / no → step 4; 4 skill: Searches flights on route and date, shows options → option list; 5 human: Agent confirms the flight, consulting the passenger if needed → selection; 6 skill: Reserves seats and enrols each passenger; applies senior discount; asks for infant allocation → enrolled passengers; 7 human: Agent confirms contact details ('yes') and the booking summary ('confirm') → approved summary; 8 skill: Generates payment link and sends by email and SMS; agent calls the passenger → link sent; 9 system: Detects payment, retrieves booking reference, updates and closes the CRM case → closed case with audit trail; 10 guardrail: Payment taken but no booking, or an integration down → critical escalation to team lead and platform support in parallel; 11 outcome: Rebooked passenger and closed case in under 5 minutes → less manual system switching
